name: zrndr_lens_flare_get_queued_sample_count
description: zRndr_LensFlare_GetQueuedSampleCount returns the current queued lens-flare sample count.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this lens-flare accessor; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zRndr lens-flare/source-cluster pass.
